Management Plan
-  Suspected viral upper respiratory infection with cough and rhinorrhea. Self-care advised: continue current over-the-counter product (contains paracetamol); avoid taking other paracetamol-containing products concurrently. Obtain a thermometer and monitor temperature. Safety-netting: seek medical review if fever persists or spikes (>37.5–38°C), cough worsens, purulent phlegm develops, hemoptysis, epistaxis, chest pain, or shortness of breath. Cough syrup not recommended during daytime; may use a small amount at night if cough prevents sleep. Diabetes confers higher risk of bacterial infection—contact clinician if not improving or worsening; antibiotics may be considered if indicated. Ensure routine diabetes and blood pressure follow-ups as advised by primary care. Patient does not currently check blood sugars at home.
